Priya — reviewed Monica’s redlines and the questions. High-level guidance below (I’ll attach a short comment file):

1) Scope: We should limit "Additional Insured" to the Order Form / scope of services for this deal only. Accepting blanket AI across the entire MSA creates risk for future work. Use this clause in the Order Form:

   "To the extent required by Customer for the Services set forth in this Order Form, Provider shall procure that Customer, and Customer’s parent and subsidiaries, are named as Additional Insured on Provider’s Commercial General Liability policy on a primary and noncontributory basis."

2) Limits: Counter-propose to accept CGL $5,000,000 per occurrence / $10,000,000 aggregate, Auto $2,000,000 combined single limit, Employers’ Liability $1,000,000. For cyber/technology E&O we should retain $5,000,000 if requested — confirm whether Greenline asked for that specifically.

3) Endorsement vs COI: Prefer an endorsement (ISO CG 20 10/11 or equivalent) as it provides contract language; COIs are informational and can be rescinded. If Greenline will accept an endorsement plus COI for timing, that is acceptable. Request waiver of subrogation to the extent permitted by law.

4) Certificate recipient: Have broker send COI and endorsement to legal@redwoodinference.com and to Priya for the deal folder. We can accept emailed PDFs from the broker.

Attachment: redline-legal-comments.docx (docx)

If you want, I can draft the exact Order Form insurance addendum and we can circulate to Monica for confirmation.

- Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
